basic_profile.bio: I'm a passionate airsoft enthusiast based in the UK, with a particular love for customizing Hi-Capa pistols. I spend my weekends either at the local airsoft field or tinkering in my workshop. Apart from airsoft, I enjoy heavy metal music and have a knack for coding, often contributing to open-source projects. I'm a software engineer by profession, which allows me the flexibility to browse Reddit during the late evenings and on lunch breaks. Currently, in a committed relationship, I often share my hobbies with my partner who is also into airsoft.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in mechanical engineering, which I pursued during my university days. My expertise in airsoft customization stems from years of hands-on experience and countless hours spent on forums and YouTube tutorials. Additionally, my coding skills are self-taught, honed through various online resources and community projects.
